outcome: mortality due to severe acute malnutrition
cohort: Maternal and child health services provided by 4956 public sector facilities in South Africa were analyzed.
finding: COVID-19 disrupted the utilisation of child health services, with an initial decline followed by an increase in subsequent months, but the recovery was not uniform across different wealth quintiles and geographical areas.
mod_finding: Change in delivery by C-section was positive but not significant.
